# FastWidget

> FastWidget is a Go library for rendering widgets quickly. This file points language models at its docs.

Widgets are immutable; build a new one instead of mutating it.

## Docs

- [Quick start](https://fastwidget.dev/docs/start.md): install and render your first widget
- [API reference](https://fastwidget.dev/docs/api.md)

## Examples

- [Dashboard](https://fastwidget.dev/examples/dashboard.md): a full dashboard in 40 lines

## Optional

- [Changelog](https://fastwidget.dev/changelog.md)
